result.reason: The operative language does not reach either playbook position because it adds no restriction on Licensor/Vendor assignments, including the required prohibition on assignment to a Customer competitor. Although it adds the Customer affiliate/M&A carve-out and removes automatic change-of-control termination, it leaves contradictory language stating when Licensor may reasonably withhold consent to a Change of Control even though consent is no longer required. It also leaves the sale-related right of first refusal operative despite the margin comment, and adds suspension and repricing prohibitions beyond the stated no-termination requirement. The changes otherwise remain focused on assignment and change-of-control matters, but the drafting is internally inconsistent and incomplete.
